facts.text: UCM partners in the Missouri Innovation Campus Program in Lee's Summit, connecting secondary, community college, and university education with over 70 area businesses.

sources.title: UCM Lee's Summit at the Missouri Innovation Campus
sources.quote: Founded in 2012, the Missouri Innovation Campus (MIC) Program is a groundbreaking partnership between the University of Central Missouri, the Lee's Summit R-7 School District, Metropolitan Community College and more than 70 Kansas City-area businesses.
